rationale: Under the two declared development evaluation cases at configured result count k=1 and the executed model, no compared configuration returned the reviewed relevant retrieval unit: aggregate recall@1 is 0 of 2 for every configuration. Embedding and hybrid configurations introduce model encoding latency and memory overhead without improving recall or precision over the baseline. Therefore, the bounded decision retains the experiment-baseline lexical retrieval configuration for these declared cases only.
